This is a company's own commercial payment term, not a statutory deadline, so no deemed-delivery or §193 BGB weekend-shift rule applies to the stated date itself; the date as printed is simply the due date. 04.12.2026 falls on a Friday, a normal business day, so no adjustment is needed regardless.
